eventDetail.scope: To bring together experts from defence and space sector, academia and industry working in the fields of range technology  for performance evaluation of weapon systems. The ICORT-2027 will provide an excellent platform for sharing novel and innovative works and results in Range Instrumentation Systems like Electro Optics, Radar, Telemetry,Command Destruct System and their associated technologies , namely RF and Microwave Engineering, Image and video processing, Communication and Digital Signal Processing, Data Science and Decision Theory etc. The aim of the conference is to create a forum for international range practitioners to share ideas, challenges and technological breakthroughs related to field of Test Ranges for performance evaluation of flight vehicles.
